title: Exact PID and PI Gain Regions for Uncertain Non-Affine MIMO Systems
summary: Characterizing all PID gains that guarantee uniform exponential regulation of uncertain nonlinear systems remains a fundamental problem. Most existing results provide only sufficient conditions derived from a particular Lyapunov construction. This paper gives exact gain regions, defined directly by uniform regulation over the entire uncertainty class, for two classes of nonaffine MIMO systems with $m\ge2$ controlled coordinates and input channels.
